Package fr.cytech.safeexit.model.simulation

Class SimulationEngine

java.lang.Object
fr.cytech.safeexit.model.observer.AbstractObservable
fr.cytech.safeexit.model.simulation.SimulationEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
Observable, Observer, Serializable
public class SimulationEngine extends AbstractObservable implements Observer
Drives the simulation one cycle at a time.

Each call to tick() advances every active agent by one step, applying the "check before entering" capacity policy: an agent only steps onto an edge if it still has room, otherwise it freezes for a couple of cycles. Movement inside a node is instantaneous; bottlenecks happen on the edges. The engine notifies observers of the events it produces and recomputes the Voronoi routes when an obstacle appears.

Version:
1.0
Author:
GROUPE E

    • triggerPanicInSector

      public int triggerPanicInSector(String sectorId)
      Manually triggers panic in a whole sector: every seated agent of that sector switches to AgentState.PANICKED (and therefore to the panicked behaviour strategy), and the sector panel shows an alert. This is the supervisor's "create a situation" tool used in demonstrations.
      Parameters:
      sectorId - the sector identifier (e.g. "SEC_1")
      Returns:
      the number of agents that switched to panic

    • calmSector

      public int calmSector(String sectorId)
      Calms a whole sector down again: every panicked spectator of that sector returns to AgentState.CALM and its panel goes back to standby. This is the counterpart of triggerPanicInSector(String) so a scenario can be undone live during a demonstration.
      Parameters:
      sectorId - the sector identifier (e.g. "SEC_1")
      Returns:
      the number of agents that returned to calm
